Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion Research Paper

Aim of the Paper

The paper seeks to carry out a descriptive analysis of a data set. Specifically, the data will focus on estimating the measures of central tendency and dispersion to provide an understanding of the average value of a dataset and how far individual values deviate from this average value. Central tendency measures are used to describe the central or typical value of a dataset, which could be the average, median, or mode, while dispersion measures are used to describe how spread out the data values are from the central value.

Introduction
-----------

Descriptive statistics are divided into two main categories, which are measures of central tendency and measures of dispersion. The measures of central tendency are used to describe the average value of a dataset or the central tendency of a dataset, such as the mean, median, and mode. The measures of dispersion are used to describe the spread out of the data values from the central value, such as range, variance, and standard deviation. The aim of this paper is to use a descriptive analysis to calculate the measures of central tendency and measure of dispersion of a data set. This will help us to understand the data set and to have a better understanding of the data.

Methodology
----------

The data used in this analysis is randomly generated from a survey conducted on 20 students in a school about their age and weight.
